questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of mandatory university health insurance plans like UHIP for international students in Canada?

options.text: To cover travel expenses during holidays
To provide coverage for basic medical services like doctor visits and hospital stays
To pay for university tuition fees
To offer discounts on gym memberships

correct_answer.text: To provide coverage for basic medical services like doctor visits and hospital stays

questions.question_text: If you have a mild fever and sore throat but can’t get a doctor’s appointment for a few days, what is the most appropriate first step to seek care in Canada?

options.text: Go directly to the emergency room (ER)
Visit a walk-in clinic or call a provincial telehealth service for advice
Wait until the symptoms worsen before seeking help
Order prescription medicine online without a consultation

correct_answer.text: Visit a walk-in clinic or call a provincial telehealth service for advice

questions.question_text: What is a common free resource offered by Canadian universities to support student mental health?

options.text: Paid private therapy sessions off-campus
Free counseling services and workshops at campus wellness centers
Mandatory fitness memberships for stress relief
Exclusive access to international travel programs

correct_answer.text: Free counselling services and workshops at campus wellness centers

questions.question_text: Which clothing item is essential for staying safe and warm during a Canadian winter with temperatures below -20°C?

options.text: A light rain jacket
A high-quality insulated winter coat rated for extreme cold
Cotton t-shirts as base layers
Open-toed sandals with socks

correct_answer.text: A high-quality insulated winter coat rated for extreme cold

questions.question_text: When should you call 9-1-1 for a medical emergency in Canada?

options.text: For a mild headache that lasts a few hours
For life-threatening conditions like chest pain or severe bleeding
For scheduling a routine doctor’s appointment
For advice on over-the-counter medications

correct_answer.text: For life-threatening conditions like chest pain or severe bleeding

questions.question_text: What is a recommended strategy to combat Seasonal Affective Disorder (SAD) during Canada’s dark winter months?

options.text: Avoid all outdoor activities until spring
Use a light therapy lamp to mimic natural sunlight
Skip regular sleep schedules to stay up later
Limit social interactions to focus on studies

correct_answer.text: Use a light therapy lamp to mimic natural sunlight
